title: The Garbage Collection Handbook: The Art of Automatic Memory Management (2nd Ed) (2023)
summary: A comprehensive technical handbook on garbage collection algorithms and automatic memory management, now in its 2nd edition (2023), covering both fundamental concepts and advanced optimization techniques used in modern programming languages and runtime systems.
problem_solved: Provides deep understanding of how to efficiently manage memory automatically, preventing memory leaks and optimizing performance in software systems.
why_valuable: Essential reference for understanding the inner workings of memory management in languages like Java, Python, and Go, helping developers write more efficient and memory-conscious code.
